containment_classes.reflex: Known deterministic condition; target machine-speed containment, normally sub-second where the affected component permits it.
containment_classes.rapid: Deterministic containment requiring dependency or state verification; target seconds, not human escalation.
containment_classes.isolate: Unknown or high-risk condition; immediately block, preserve or degrade safely while autonomous investigation continues.
